title: Recent Extra-Principal Payments Counted for the Reinstatement Credit
content:
Plan ledger conventions — **Patient Payment Plans**: the extra-principal payments that the reinstatement credit counts on a defaulted plan.

## Convention

Which of the extra-principal payments posted less than 6 whole months before today the reinstatement credit counts depends on how the plan was paid:

- on a plan without automatic payments on which some of those payments were made by check, only the payments made by check;
- on a plan with automatic payments, only the most recent of those payments;
- on any other plan, all of them.

"Those payments" are the payments on the plan ledger posted as extra-principal payments and dated less than 6 whole months before today. "Automatic payments" reads the plan's automatic-payment setting, whatever the method on file.

## Selection table

| Automatic payments on the plan | Any of those payments made by check | Payments counted |
|---|---|---|
| No | Yes | Only the ones made by check, added together |
| No | No | All of them, added together |
| Yes | any | Only the most recent one |

## Hypothetical ledger

Extra-principal payments in the span, oldest first: 50.00 by check, 30.00 by debit card, 20.00 by check. One more, 45.00 by check, was posted 7 whole months ago.

- Plan paid manually: some were made by check, so the check payments in the span are counted: 50.00 and 20.00, that is 70.00. The 45.00 is outside the span.
- Plan with automatic draws: only the most recent, 20.00.
- Plan paid manually whose payments in the span were 30.00 and 25.00, both by debit card: none by check, so all of them, 55.00.
